caption: The drawing depicts a single figure standing on a rectangular pedestal. The figure is human-like and wears a brownish costume that covers its entire body, including a tall, pointed hat with a rounded end that tilts forward and has a small pattern near the tip. The face is exaggerated with pronounced eyes, eyebrows, nose, and a wide, toothy grin. The figure has a large ruffled collar that is gray with light blue and white highlights, encircling its neck. The costume is accented with gold-colored ornamental patterns along the sides, cuffs, and edges. The figure's hands are clenched, with the right hand raised and the left hand held closer to its body, each showing circular detailing on the palm. The legs are clad in the same brown suit with gold designs and end in boots or shoes of the same color. The pedestal is composed of multiple brown and tan rectangular layers. The background is a plain beige color with a thin red border containing a second thin black line inside it. The drawing appears to be signed “Elmer G. Anderson” in the lower left and is labeled “1/8 full size” in the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Figure
